_comments: IT SHIPS DISABLED, like the other orders jobs, so a lower environment does not start filling the
finance review list the moment this lands. There is no Preview step: the pass writes only review
rows, blocks nothing, and is idempotent per line per month. Enable it once accounting's
04:00 UTC, after the 03:00 renewal and 03:30 payment-access passes. The operation measures against
the business day, not the hour, so any hour of the right day selects the same lines. Daily because
a line crosses the threshold on a day, not a month; the monthly dedupe key keeps that from raising
a line more than once a month. ConcurrencyMode Skip, MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: a catch-up is one
run. RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun false: the first run waits for the schedule.
OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID are unset: they name people, which differ per environment.

fields.Name: Orders — Detect Unattested Progress (daily)
fields.Description: Puts percentage-of-completion order lines overdue for a progress attestation on accounting's finance exception review list, one exception per line per month, using the PROGRESS_UNATTESTED type's MaxDaysWithoutAttestation. Ships disabled: enable it once that type is configured.
